_doc: Which model runs the independent QA evaluator, and the model-family table the cross-model rule uses (Factory Completion Plan Step 7; CLAUDE.md §6: the evaluator is never the builder's instance, and ideally not its model or vendor). Read by src/crossModel.ts and src/modelClient.ts. 'candidates' is tried in order: the first whose family differs from the builder's AND whose key is in the environment wins; none = the evaluator does not run and the run ends 'not verified' (never approved). A builder and evaluator that resolve to the same family are refused loudly at composition (productionQaOptions, npm run verify). A model that matches no family is refused too (fail closed). Prices come from packages/hermes/config/model-routing.json (the one price table). Change = bump version.

candidates.why: Default since Phase 5: mid tier for a whole-site judgment; a different family from today's Agent 37 builder.

Second vendor, used when the builder is Claude (Agent 37 not configured: the builder falls back to Claude) so the evaluator is still another family. Status 2026-10-01: the OpenAI account had no credits (HTTP 429); re-checked in the Step 7 report.

families.caveat: Agent 37 is a self-hosted Nous Research 'Hermes Agent' gateway; it does not disclose which upstream model answers. Treated as its own family on the gateway's self-description (routing decision 2026-09-22). NOT independently verified.
Test doubles only. Two mocks are the same family unless a test gives them distinct families.
